model.independence: Uses only box scores, minutes, pace and the game engine. Exchange prices are never an input; they are compared afterwards.
model.injuries: No NBA injury feed is connected. A rotation player who missed his team's last two games is treated as out; anyone else is assumed available.

notes: Each game day is projected with games before that day only; graded on players who played.
Players projected under 18 minutes and thresholds below 2% or above 98% are not scored.
Baseline: share of the player's last 20 games (this season and last) that cleared the threshold, smoothed.
There is no NBA injury feed: a rotation player who missed his team's last two games is treated as out; otherwise players are assumed available.
Each game day is simulated with a fixed seed (the date as YYYYMMDD) per game and team, so every number reproduces.
No historical prop prices: ROI and closing-line value need stored market snapshots.
